docs.title: Voxy Dev
docs.text:
Voxy Dev is a voice assistant that speaks on your company's behalf

Voxy Dev is a customizable voice assistant that interacts with your customers via phone or other voice channels. It can handle common tasks like creating, managing, or canceling orders—automatically, 24/7.

If your team spends a lot of time on routine conversations, Voxy Dev can serve as your first-line support agent—freeing your specialists to focus on more meaningful and complex interactions.

Voxy Dev doesn’t replace a good human representative. It complements your team by taking care of the repetitive work—efficiently, consistently, and professionally.

docs.title: Built for Your Needs, Not Ours
docs.text:
Voxy Dev isn’t a fixed product with rigid features. It’s a tailored service designed around your business needs.

We build your voice assistant using industry-leading platforms:

  • OpenAI – Advanced conversational intelligence

  • Twilio or SIP protocol – Seamless phone and voice channel integration

  • ElevenLabs – High-quality speech-to-text and text-to-speech

Let us help you create a voice experience that truly represents your brand.
